requirements.requirement: Actual behavior of a system update against curl was validated (i.e., that a real update run would skip curl)
requirements.summary: Node1 has zero enabled yum repos (repolist: 0), so no real 'yum update' with available candidate packages could be executed to directly observe the exclude directive skipping curl during an update. Only static config validation (yum parses config, exclude line present) and unchanged rpm version were captured. This is an environment limitation (no repos) rather than an executor omission, but it means the update-time exclusion behavior itself was never directly exercised.
